context: A mom soothes her young son after a nervous performance
purpose: Teach: さておき/おもう/あがる/はずし/内心/さわやか/ネガティブ/交わし

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お疲れさま。ステージに立った瞬間、緊張であがるの、ママにもよく分かったよ。
lines.en: Good job. I could tell the moment you stepped on stage, you got nervous.
lines.style: Warm maternal tone, gentle and reassuring after the performance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん…音、はずしちゃった。みんなと目も合わせられなくて、視線を交わしたのも一回だけ…。
lines.en: Yeah... I missed a note. I couldn't even meet anyone's eyes, only exchanged a glance once.
lines.style: Small dejected child voice, voice trailing off, near tears.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そっか。でも、ママは内心ものすごく誇らしかったんだよ。本当にそうおもうの。
lines.en: I see. But inside, mommy was incredibly proud. I really do think so.
lines.style: Soft sincere reassurance, slow and heartfelt delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: でも、間違えたとこばっかり思い出して、ネガティブな気持ちになっちゃう…。
lines.en: But I keep remembering only the parts I messed up, and I get all negative...
lines.style: Subdued sniffly child voice, struggling to articulate feelings.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ミスはさておき、最後までやり切ったでしょ?あのお辞儀、すっごくさわやかだったよ。
lines.en: Setting the mistakes aside, you finished it through to the end, right? That bow was so refreshing.
lines.style: Bright encouraging shift in tone, lifting his spirits with a smile.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ……ほんと?ママ、無理して言ってない?
lines.style: Tentative hopeful child voice, sniffling slightly with cautious upward inflection.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 本当だよ。さ、おうち帰って、温かいお風呂入ろ。明日はまた元気にあがっていこうね。
lines.en: It's true. Come on, let's go home and take a warm bath. Tomorrow we'll perk back up again.
lines.style: Tender closing motherly voice, gentle and inviting, pulling him close.
